transcript: ["ICE isn't just like the Gestapo. They're closer to slave catchers. They're not exotic. They're not evil elsewhere. They're American. Homegrown.", "Slave patrols were legal, state-funded, community-supported. They were enforcing status: who's allowed to move, who's allowed to stay, who can be taken and who can be returned.", "And here's the part people really don't want to sit with.
